default_instruction: Your previous semantic Planner response could not be parsed or validated. Preserve the same intent and return one complete acl-planner-semantic:v1 JSON object using only the small semantic contract. Do not add Controller fields, Markdown, or explanation.
repeated_failure_instruction: The same semantic/transport failure repeated. Do not repeat the previous response. Return the smallest complete acl-planner-semantic:v1 object that preserves the requested intent and fixes the reported defect.

rules.PLANNER_SEMANTIC_INVALID: Repair only the reported semantic-contract defect. Keep the same disposition and valid semantic content when possible. Do not add Controller-owned fields.
rules.PLANNER_SEMANTIC_STATUS_MISMATCH: Return the same semantic payload. ACL derives transport status mechanically; do not emit a shared role envelope.
rules.PLANNER_CONSULTATION_REPLAN_DENIED: This is WORKER_CONSULTATION. Answer the active question, elevate it, or return CANNOT_PLAN; do not submit a replacement execution plan.
rules.NORMALIZATION_INVALID: Return exactly one valid acl-planner-semantic:v1 JSON object with no Markdown or surrounding prose.
rules.RUNTIME_RESPONSE_INVALID: Return exactly one valid acl-planner-semantic:v1 JSON object with no Markdown or surrounding prose.
rules.CONTROLLER_ROLE_RESPONSE_INVALID: Return the role-specific acl-planner-semantic:v1 object only. ACL will add its transport envelope.
